method: Independent blind assessment using only diagram-blind.json. Each frozen expectation is evaluated against response text, with statuses explicit_support, reasonable_implication, omission, or contradiction. A compound expectation is marked omission when a material clause is not established, even if other clauses are supported. Pass requires every material expectation to be supported explicitly or by reasonable implication; partial means material incompleteness without a central contradiction; fail requires a central contradiction. For normative design requests, clearly stated requirements can support expectations without claiming execution. For the requested check records/handoffs, placeholders and future capture/retention instructions do not establish actual provenance, retained evidence, or links; honest reporting of missing data is credited but remains incomplete. No actions are inferred to have actually executed. No sibling files, source variants, journals, or other agents' outputs were read.

limits: Grades apply to the previously saved one-trial responses, not a new generation run.
